title: scheelea wallisii
intro: Scheelea wallisii, commonly known as the Guiana mahogany, is a tropical tree species native to the Guiana Shield. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relief from stress, anxiety, and insomnia due to its calming effects. Scheelea wallisii's health benefits are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. The plant's extracts have been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine.
